moves.name: identify-offence
moves.desc: Decide which offence the facts may fall under

moves.name: check-ingredient
moves.desc: Test each ingredient of the offence against the facts

moves.name: infer-intention
moves.desc: Infer the mental element from conduct and circumstances

moves.name: distinguish-neighbour
moves.desc: Separate the offence from neighbouring offences by the deciding ingredient

moves.name: cite-authority
moves.desc: Support each point with leading judgments

pitfalls: ignoring the time at which intention is formed
analogies: medicine/differential diagnosis: elements ≈ criteria, neighbours ≈ differentials
test: unseen fact patterns with minimal pairs; held-out sections; base vs pack
